script.problem: The one line is more than one sentence.
Moment 3's passage 2 Samuel 6:9-11 doesn't include a verse that names Perez-uzzah in the lessons.

terra.problem: Perez-uzzah is described as a place, not a city. Neither the verses nor Easton’s identifies it as a city.
The line gives the reason for the name as its meaning. Easton’s gives the meaning as “the breach of Uzzah.”
“It is still called that to this day” may suggest the place has that name today. The verse refers to the time when the account was written.
In the third moment, taking the ark to Obed-edom’s house involves travel away from Perez-uzzah, so not every event in the moment happens at the named place.
“Irreverence” may be difficult for a fifth-grade reader; a simpler word such as “disrespect” would be easier to understand.
